classification_legend.implemented: Capability exists in current code/tests and the remaining drift is task/document state.
classification_legend.partially_implemented: Some supporting code or contract exists, but the target dynamic-kernel semantics are incomplete.
classification_legend.documented_only: Architecture or task documents exist, but there is no runtime/schema/test implementation yet.
classification_legend.duplicate: Two or more artifacts currently express the same authority or content.
classification_legend.dead_path: A previously planned execution path has been superseded and must not be advanced.
